settings.label: One unfinished point is still replaying.
settings.result_heading: Give the unfinished point a return place.
settings.acknowledgement: An open point can keep asking for attention because tomorrow has no visible place to begin.
settings.promise: In a few minutes, you will leave one clear return point and close one work surface.
settings.step_1_body: Choose one item—not the whole list.
settings.step_2_body: Make it specific enough that tomorrow-you knows exactly where to begin.
settings.step_3_body: Close the tab, notebook or device. The work is not finished; today’s window is.

settings.label: My body still feels switched on.
settings.result_heading: Change the physical signals around you.
settings.acknowledgement: Sometimes effort stays in the body after the task itself has ended.
settings.promise: You will make one safe physical change and choose a lower-demand next action.
settings.step_1_body: Let your feet meet the floor or your back meet a chair.
settings.step_2_body: Change rooms, loosen one layer, drink water or change the light.
settings.step_3_body: A meal, shower, gentle movement or quiet is enough.

settings.label: I keep checking and cannot disengage.
settings.result_heading: Create distance from the cue pulling you back.
settings.acknowledgement: Checking can keep a work window open long after its useful part has finished.
settings.promise: You will make the next genuine check explicit—or decide there is no next check tonight.
settings.step_1_body: An inbox, message, task or uncertainty is enough.
settings.step_2_body: Close the inbox, turn over the phone or move the work device out of reach.
settings.step_3_body: Choose a sensible later time only if one is genuinely needed.

settings.label: Work is over, but the evening has not begun.
settings.result_heading: Give your attention one ordinary place to land.
settings.acknowledgement: The day can end without attention landing anywhere yet.
settings.promise: You will orient to what is here and begin one ordinary next thing.
settings.step_1_body: Notice three ordinary things without interpreting them.
settings.step_2_body: Food, water, movement, a person, a shower or quiet.
settings.step_3_body: It does not need to be the perfect recovery activity.

settings.heading: Work has ended. Why is it still with you?
